[P2] Document the required simplification comparison

Rule 2, “Simplify before you add,” requires the description to identify simpler options and explain why they do not work when adding logic. This handler adds another copy of `Telemetry1Success`’s environment validation and telemetry configuration, but the description contains no such comparison. That leaves two independently maintained implementations of the same setup without a stated reason. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6; consider sharing the existing setup and record the chosen approach and rationale before revising the implementation.
